construction_validation_rule: No validation checkpoint, energy, spectrum, continuation, or application value may set a source charge, gain, mechanism label, spectral threshold, downstream bound, or remainder radius.

predictions.name: exact_gate_identity
predictions.statement: Final-gate rescaling multiplies every row difference by the same factor; a zero gate produces the constant bias row; and the global architecture bound encloses all registered pairs.

predictions.name: schedule_capture
predictions.statement: At least one source-fixed post-warmup eight-update block has a residual-padded ordered 48-dimensional gain below one, even if one or more constituent updates expand.

predictions.name: source_owned_energy_enclosure
predictions.statement: Construction-owned gate, directional-shape, and remainder charges enclose every validation energy node, while forcing and direct product charges enclose their corresponding validation data.

predictions.name: mechanism_and_intervention_decomposition
predictions.statement: The construction classification as gate-led, shape-led, or mixed replicates on the validation trajectory. Every matched continuation obeys the exact gate-shape energy decomposition, and the final-gate freeze has identically zero gate work.

predictions.name: plga_secant_transfer
predictions.statement: Exact occupied-interval secants reconstruct the PLGA deductive difference and enclose the held-out centered-logit difference.
